parole.significato: Any of several Central American trees of the genera Libidibia or Croton.
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish cascalote, nacascolote (“divi-divi”), from Nahuatl nacazcolotl (literally “twisted ear”), from nacaztli (“ear”) + colotl (“twisted”).

parole.significato: A wattle-and-mud hut common in Mexico and the southwestern US.
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish jacal, from Nahuatl xacalli.

parole.significato: A Mexican alcoholic drink distilled from the fermented juice of the agave.
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish mezcal, from Nahuatl or Classical Nahuatl mexcalli (“intoxicating drink made from fermented agave juice”), perhaps from metl (“maguey (agave)”) + ixcalli (“stew”).

parole.significato: A milk-colored, somewhat viscous Mexican alcoholic drink made from the fermented sap of certain agave plants.
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish pulque, possibly from Nahuatl.

parole.significato: A Mexican dish consisting of a fried and stuffed masa cake.
parole.testo: From Mexican Spanish tlacoyo, from Nahuatl tlahtlaōyoh.
